title: pin/unpin SQL uses integer literal 1/0 for postgres boolean
description: In fieldwork-db/src/articles_db.rs, pin_article (line 470) and unpin_article (line 486) use 'pinned = 1' and 'pinned = 0' in the Postgres branch. While Postgres will accept integer literals for boolean columns via implicit cast, the correct SQL is 'pinned = true'/'pinned = false'. The same pattern appears in list_collection_articles (line 337: 'draft = 0'). The sqlite branches correctly use integers since SQLite lacks a boolean type. The create_article function already handles this correctly by converting bools to i32 before binding.
close_reason: Already fixed in xzkb.23: pin_article uses 'pinned = true', unpin_article uses 'pinned = false' for Postgres.
